title: Citizen Promaster Diver BN0150 vs Longines HydroConquest 41mm
summary_winner: The Longines, if you want the watch to be an object. It is smaller at 41 mm, rated deeper at 300 m, and Swiss automatic, and it sits a price band higher, which is the entire point of it. The Citizen wins on everything unglamorous: solar means no winding, no battery changes and no service interval, and it will keep better time than the Longines ever will. Buy the Citizen if you want a diver you never have to think about. Buy the Longines if thinking about it is part of what you are paying for.
